_comment: Live-corpus watchlist for the RH proof program. Built by grepping docs/03_research/reading_notes/, references/ READMEs, and docs/03_research/*.md for arXiv identifiers, then curated down to the papers this project's live constructions actually depend on or actively track (the Weil-positivity section-10 corpus, the CCM/Connes-Consani lineage, and the named-author WATCH list from sourcing_gap_r1.md and the periodic watch_sweep notes). Not every citation in the repo is here: this is the subset where a new version or a new listing is actionable within days, not the full historical bibliography.

papers.note: Suzuki, 'Weil's quadratic form via the screw function'. Conjecture (1.2) (ground-state Fourier transform -> xi(1/2+iz)) is exactly the object this project's experiments (B2c/e2at) probe numerically. v2 dated 2026-08-18; MANDATORY watch.
Connes-Consani-Moscovici, 'Zeta Spectral Triples'. Lemma 7.3 and the Section 7 determinant-class limit are load-bearing for this project's M4/frontier work (LEARNINGS #186, e2at). MANDATORY watch.

'Quadratic Forms, Real Zeros and Echoes of the Spectral Action' (CCM-adjacent). Tracked alongside 2511.22755 as part of the D_log family line; recently moved from arXiv-only to a CMP print run with no new arXiv content, so a version bump here would be a real signal.
Suzuki, 'Screw line of the Riemann zeta function' (2022). The screw-function substrate that Suzuki 2606.09096 builds on and that this project's #171 de Branges corridor work engaged directly.
'Hilbert-Schmidt Integral Operator and the Weil Distribution'. Trace-class operator adjacent to the Weil distribution with a nonnegative-eigenvalue construction; section-10 Weil-positivity corpus.
Connes-Consani, 'Weil positivity and trace formula the archimedean place'. The CC half of the localized-form operator story that CCM 2511.22755 and Suzuki 2606.09096 both build on.

Gonek, 'Finite Euler products and the Riemann Hypothesis'. RH iff short truncated Euler products approximate zeta in most of the right half-strip; the in-print home for this project's e2ap Part-B S-finite Euler ladder.

Gonek-Hughes-Keating, 'A Hybrid Euler-Hadamard product formula for the Riemann zeta function'. Primes and zeros as complementary factors; context for this project's two-meter law. Old-style arXiv ID (pre-2007 scheme).

Broucke-Debruyne-Vindas, 'Beurling integers with RH and large oscillation'. Neighbouring theory for this project's Beurling discipline / Cramer control (counting data underdetermines analytic structure).
Carneiro et al., Fourier-optimization / pair-correlation extremal-function paper. The community for this project's band-ceiling (Omega) extremal question (#181(ii)).
Consani, 2026 listing. Named-author watch (Connes/Consani/Moscovici/van Suijlekom lineage); tracked in watch_sweep_2026-07-18.md as already-known so a version bump or successor is the signal.
Connes-Consani, 'Absolute Geometry and Spec(Z)' (2026). Direct CCM-lineage successor; read at depth in this project's reading notes.
Groskin, CCM D_log truncation precursor. The lineage that 2607.02828 continues; watch for a follow-up turning its technique toward the Section-7 uniform-limit (M4) question.

Groskin, truncated Weil quadratic form (Guinand-Weil dictionary + archimedean-tail positivity certification). CCM-axis infrastructure paper, explicitly disclaims any RH claim; watch for a follow-up that does make one.
Connes, 'RH: Past, Present...' letter (2026). Named-author watch; direct statement of the program's current self-assessment from its principal author.

Michalowski, Polya-frequency order of the de Bruijn-Newman kernel. Convergent independent work on Direction 12 (de Bruijn-Newman criticality); watch for any result reaching Lambda <= 0 rather than the current Lambda <= 0.22 upper bound.

Dor-Hrushovski, model-theoretic Frobenius limit theory. Explicit WATCH item in sourcing_gap_r1.md: the one corner of the model-theoretic corpus moving toward L-function data; re-check for any archimedean or global place entering.

Kulikov-Nazarov-Sodin (lineage), 'Critical and asymmetric Fourier uniqueness pairs'. Named-author watch (Fourier-uniqueness / irregular-nodes school); surfaced incidentally in watch_sweep_2026-07-18.md, not yet first-read.
'Spectral Criteria for Uniqueness Pairs of Unitary Transforms'. Same named-author watch as 2509.17600; both flagged for a first-read check in the next sweep cycle.

Drinfeld-module RH preprint. The closest comparator this project's R1 sourcing-gap audit found to a variety-free purity source (fails: function-field only, not Spec(Z)); watch for any generalization attempt toward the global base.

Metaplectic self-dual Sonin projector. Flagged in sourcing_gap_r1.md as the sole unbuilt S4-carrier variant after this project's e1r/e1s probes closed every buildable family; watch for any paper that constructs it.

Chen-Moriwaki, arithmetic Hilbert-Samuel positivity over adelic curves. Graded ADJACENT-WATCH in reading_notes/README.md: generalizes the base (not a self-product), wrong polarity for M4 as stated, but the nearest per-variety positivity result to this project's target.

keyword_queries.note: Guards the localization program (Yoshida/Bombieri/CC/CCM/Suzuki) this project's #180/#181 margin and ground-state measurements sit inside.
Guards the broader explicit-formula literature underlying Architecture 3 (direct positivity) and the S-finite Euler ladder.
Guards the Li-criterion positivity literature (lambda_n >= 0), one of this project's two named Architecture-3 objects.
Guards the Nyman-Beurling density criterion, one of the two open Level-4 routes not yet given a D-H discrimination test.

Guards the de Branges-space literature: the corridor this project's #163/#164/#171 rounds closed for their own reasons, and the language Suzuki 2606.09096 now formulates the whole localization program in.

Guards the determinant-class trace-formula shape (the W6 spec in sourcing_gap_r1.md): a carrier on which xi(s) is the regularized characteristic polynomial of one operator with an independently computable pole budget.
Broad catch-all for any new positivity-criterion paper that does not use the other six queries' specific vocabulary.
